object: upper-plate aftershocks of the 2014 Iquique megathrust earthquake
problem: Which postseismic process (afterslip, viscoelastic relaxation, pore-pressure diffusion) drives upper-plate aftershock timing and distribution?
mechanism_or_method: 4D poroelastic/viscoelastic model fitted to geodetic data, with stress changes per process compared with aftershock spatiotemporal distribution.
limitation: Single earthquake case; model assumptions on rheology and permeability are uncertain.
decision_relevance: Informs time-dependent aftershock hazard assessment near subduction zones.

problem: Why do electroadhesive clutches fail at low voltage and how can force per voltage be raised?
mechanism_or_method: Fracture-mechanics analysis with strain-field imaging revealed delamination; soft interlayer and peeling stopper equalize stress distribution.
limitation: Lab-scale 1 cm2 clutches; durability and environmental robustness not established in the abstract.
decision_relevance: Guides clutch layer design for low-voltage wearable force control.

object: single-ion quantum heat engine with quantum battery
problem: Can a quantum engine be both energy efficient and quantum-advantaged?
mechanism_or_method: Trapped-ion engine coupled to a quantum battery, using shortcut-to-adiabaticity protocols to suppress quantum friction.
limitation: Single-ion proof of concept; scaling to useful power levels is not shown.

problem: What particle-level structural defect generates quasi-localised modes and mechanical anisotropy in glasses?
mechanism_or_method: Molecular dynamics identifies a four-particle key-core vibrating two-in two-out as an Eshelby inclusion; pinning it reduces anisotropy.
limitation: Only 2D model glasses; relevance to real 3D glasses is not shown.

problem: How can mechanical instability be used to build large-area chiral supramolecular structures?
mechanism_or_method: Shear-triggered film instability drives crystallization into lamellar and left/right-handed fibers, analyzed with theoretical modeling.
limitation: Demonstrated for a single molecule (ibuprofen); generality across compounds not shown.

object: seed sorting conveyor with ultrasonic phased arrays
problem: Can acoustic radiation forces eject substandard seeds on conveyor belts with camera-based quality selection?
mechanism_or_method: Phased-array transducers focus acoustic beams to eject seeds with variable distance based on camera-detected size and color.
limitation: Lab conveyor tests only; industrial throughput and seed variety not established.
decision_relevance: Offers alternative to air-jet ejection in seed sorting lines.

problem: Can information transmission and storage be realised in artificial spin ice via a controllable glider?
mechanism_or_method: Evolutionary algorithm discovers the snake glider controlled by a global field protocol, verified in simulation and experiment.
limitation: Robustness to disorder is limited; scaling to large computing devices not shown.

problem: How can robots achieve high speed, high load capacity and multimodal locomotion in a simple structure?
mechanism_or_method: Liquid-amplified electrostatic rolling integrates actuation and adhesion in a single-degree-of-freedom roller structure.
limitation: Mostly tethered prototypes; untethered versions are preliminary with limited demonstrated endurance.
decision_relevance: Supports choosing electrostatic rolling for fast lightweight microrobots.

problem: Can light momentum alone drive large mechanical deformation of micro-waveguides?
mechanism_or_method: Two-photon-polymerized curved nanowire waveguides deform under guided light, predicted by an analytical optomechanical model.
limitation: Micron-scale devices; actuation speed and power efficiency for applications not quantified.

problem: Can one cognitive model explain human collision avoidance across multiple scenarios?
mechanism_or_method: Active inference model with evidence accumulation reproduces response timing and maneuver selection in three scenarios.
limitation: Validated against meta-analyses and simulator studies, not on-road naturalistic driving.
decision_relevance: Supports human-behavior models for testing automated vehicle safety.

object: mechanical hysterons from bars and springs
problem: How can hysterons with tunable interactions of arbitrary sign be built in elastic structures?
mechanism_or_method: Rigid-bar and linear-spring hysteron with derived parameter mapping, enabling reciprocal or non-reciprocal tunable interactions.
limitation: Small numbers of hysterons demonstrated; scaling to many interacting units is not shown.
decision_relevance: Provides a design route to mechanical memory and computing materials.

problem: How can growth-induced macroscopic shape transformation be controlled in synthetic polymers?
mechanism_or_method: Spatially controlled anionic ring-opening polymerization of D4 induces mass transport that reshapes silicone samples.
limitation: Demonstrated for one silicone chemistry; growth rate and scalability limits unclear.

problem: Can passive single-material structures decompose sound into spatio-spectral components efficiently?
mechanism_or_method: Computational morphogenesis designs acoustic rainbow and wavelength splitter structures with above-unity efficiency.
limitation: Abstract reports no physical validation; manufacturing and viscothermal losses are unaddressed.

problem: How can miniature robotic boats self-assemble and reconfigure autonomously on water despite hydrodynamic disturbances?
mechanism_or_method: FloatForm modules with distributed controllers plus minimalist central planner in a hybrid coordination framework.
limitation: Two-dimensional water surface in lab conditions; outdoor waves and larger scale not tested.

object: cascaded diffractive layers for light refraction
problem: Can arbitrary refraction permutations between input and output directions be programmed in a thin material?
mechanism_or_method: Cascaded transmissive layers with optimized phase profiles form a refractive function generator, 3D printed for terahertz.
limitation: Demonstrated at terahertz only; extension to visible wavelengths requires nanofabrication.

problem: Can closed-loop machine learning plus experiment find better direct N2O decomposition catalysts?
mechanism_or_method: 37 cycles of ML prediction and experiment over 633 catalysts, followed by control and in situ characterization.
limitation: Catalyst stability and performance under real exhaust conditions are not shown in the abstract.

object: machine learning potentials for metallic alloys
problem: How can MLPs be trained to capture alloy behavior across all compositions and chemical orderings?
mechanism_or_method: Information-theory-based optimized sampling of chemical motifs to train MLPs for AuPt, CuAu, CrCoNi and TiTaVW alloys.
limitation: Tested on four alloy systems; training cost and transferability to other systems remain open.

object: crack problems solved by physics-informed neural networks
problem: How can the deep energy method be extended to unified, accurate discrete and phase-field fracture prediction with sparse points?
mechanism_or_method: XDEM adds displacement discontinuities and crack-tip asymptotics, and couples displacement with phase fields in a neural energy framework.
limitation: Validated on benchmark problems only; complex 3D and experimental cases are not shown.

object: spirocyclic polymer membranes for azeotrope separation
problem: Can a pressure-driven microporous membrane separate alcohol-hydrocarbon azeotropes with far lower energy than distillation?
mechanism_or_method: Spirocyclic poly(vinylene ether ketone) membrane with enhanced microporosity, surface adsorption affinity and restricted hydrocarbon diffusion.
limitation: Long-term stability and performance on real industrial mixtures are not reported.

object: porous valve for subsea bubble energy harvesting
problem: How can energy be harvested efficiently from low-flux subsea bubbles?
mechanism_or_method: Passive porous valve uses gas-liquid interface Laplace pressure to accumulate bubbles then release them rapidly.
limitation: Tested in laboratory with a small sensor load; field subsea validation is absent.
decision_relevance: Informs passive valve design for powering low-power subsea sensors.

problem: How can real-time, programmable infrared information encryption be achieved?
mechanism_or_method: Eight-layer relaxor ferroelectric polymer stack fabricated via bistable adhesion transfer generates electrocaloric temperature waves.
limitation: Small temperature change (about 4 K) and low frequency limit data rate and range.

object: actuated polymeric microneedles with plasmonic particles
problem: Can soft actuation dynamically tune plasmonic particle gaps for hot-spot engineering and sensing?
mechanism_or_method: Magnetically or pneumatically actuated microneedles decorated with silver or gold nanoparticles amplify Raman signals.
limitation: Demonstrated with model analytes; real-sample sensing performance is not shown.

problem: What governs thermal transport across diverse ZIF topologies and linkers?
mechanism_or_method: Thermal circuit model integrating network topology, validated against simulated conductivity of 196 ZIF structures.
limitation: Validated against simulations rather than measurements; amorphous and defective frameworks are not covered.

problem: Can individual tactoid morphology be reversibly controlled at sub-micron resolution?
mechanism_or_method: Multiphoton absorption photothermal effect locally melts nematic order to cut, ablate and self-heal single tactoids.
limitation: Short-term memory only; recovery within minutes limits information storage durability.

object: ionomer films with photonic crystal structures
problem: How can light-induced feedback grow programmable multiscale photonic crystal structures?
mechanism_or_method: Anthracene photodimerization under UV drives phase separation and nanoparticle column growth following light propagation.
limitation: Specific ionomer system; long-term optical stability and large-area uniformity not described.

problem: How can complex hierarchical nanoporous copper structures be printed rapidly with tunable porosity?
mechanism_or_method: Micro continuous liquid interface production of copper-monomer composites with high filler loading, then low-temperature sintering.
limitation: Sintered structures shrink and oxidize; mechanical properties of porous parts are barely characterized.
decision_relevance: Guides sintering temperature choice for porosity versus oxidation resistance.

problem: How does snow weak-layer fracture transition from sub-Rayleigh to supershear propagation?
mechanism_or_method: Triggered avalanches on a slope with high-speed imaging and digital image correlation, supported by simulations of Burridge-Andrews mechanism.
limitation: Small slope experiments; link between supershear and avalanche size remains a suggestion.
decision_relevance: Informs avalanche release size assessment for risk mitigation.

problem: What is the momentum dependence and spatial correlation of the boson peak in amorphous materials?
mechanism_or_method: Inelastic neutron scattering, heat capacity, Raman and MD on Zr-Cu-Al glasses show BP intensity scaling with static structure factor.
limitation: Limited to a model Zr-Cu-Al glass and Lennard-Jones simulation.

problem: Does logarithmic frictional healing hold for feldspar under hydrothermal conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrothermal slide-hold-slide experiments on feldspar and rocks, plus nano-scale friction tests on single crystals.
limitation: Laboratory timescales; extrapolation to natural fault recurrence intervals is uncertain.
decision_relevance: Questions extrapolating lab healing parameters to earthquake recurrence modeling.

problem: Does positronium exhibit matter-wave diffraction as a single quantum entity?
mechanism_or_method: Energy-tunable positronium beam transmitted through graphene with time-of-flight selection and spatially resolved detection.
limitation: Only first-order peak observed; precision limited by beam quality.

object: binary colloidal systems with mobile DNA bonds
problem: Which self-assembly pathways yield floppy colloidal square lattices?
mechanism_or_method: Surface-mobile DNA bonds enable reconfigurability; size ratio, number ratio and shape directionality analyzed by experiments, calculations and simulation.
limitation: Model colloidal system; yield and scale relevant to practical materials unclear.

problem: How can overloading risk under N-k contingencies and renewable uncertainty be assessed quickly for tens of thousands of buses?
mechanism_or_method: Deep-kernel sparse vector-valued Gaussian process surrogate with adaptive resampling guided by power flow solver near the threshold.
limitation: Evaluated on a simulated test system rather than operator data; contingency set is predefined.
decision_relevance: Speeds up grid operator screening of overload risk with high renewables.

problem: How can causes of production anomalies be identified and explained from coupled manufacturing factors?
mechanism_or_method: EM2PA combines data augmentation, influence factor recognition and causal interpretation within a digital twin.
limitation: Single workshop case study; relies on proprietary production data and small abnormal samples.
decision_relevance: Helps trace root causes of production anomalies on discrete manufacturing lines.

object: engineered Issatchenkia orientalis yeast for oxalic acid
problem: Can bio-oxalic acid from yeast fermentation sustainably recover rare earth elements?
mechanism_or_method: Oxaloacetate cleavage pathway and metabolic engineering give 39.5 g/L oxalate; crude broth precipitates rare earths.
limitation: Lab fed-batch scale; techno-economics rely on modeled rather than pilot plant data.

problem: Can acoustic waves deterministically control and generate kinks despite the Peierls-Nabarro barrier?
mechanism_or_method: Topological metamaterial with zero-energy kink removes the PN barrier; experiments and computation reveal phonon-kink dynamics.
limitation: Specific lab metamaterial; applications such as stiffness tuning remain prospective.

object: liquid solvent direct air capture regeneration
problem: Can catalysts and hybrid solvents cut thermal energy of membrane vacuum regeneration in direct air capture?
mechanism_or_method: Iron-sulfated zirconia catalysts on silica combined with potassium taurinate/sarcosinate hybrid solvent in low-temperature membrane vacuum regeneration.
limitation: Bench-scale results; catalyst durability and scale-up energy are not shown.

problem: How can hydrogels be reinforced while also increasing energy dissipation?
mechanism_or_method: Starch granule fillers cause polymer bundling for reinforcement and transient hydrogen bonding for dissipation; interface charge tuned.
limitation: Mechanism is proposed rather than directly proven; limited filler types examined.
decision_relevance: Guides filler choice for tough, dissipative soft composites.

problem: How can the safety performance stagnation (seesaw effect) in autonomous vehicle deep learning be broken?
mechanism_or_method: Dense learning samples data by policy-gradient contribution and exposure frequency, reducing variance without bias; tested in mixed reality.
limitation: Validated on an urban test track with mixed reality, not open-road traffic.
decision_relevance: Changes how safety-critical driving policies are trained and validated.

object: lithium leaching from spent NCM cathodes
problem: How can electric energy consumption be minimized in electrochemical lithium leaching?
mechanism_or_method: Two-stage electrochemical dual-oxidation followed by soaking relaxation driven by lattice oxygen oxidation.
limitation: Lab-scale tests on NCM111; other chemistries and scale-up not demonstrated.

problem: How can a passive thermal switch achieve very high switching ratios?
mechanism_or_method: Cut-and-fold thin film with snap-through instability actuated by shape-memory alloy and springs, tunable by geometry.
limitation: Lab prototypes; cycle life and integration in real electronics not reported.
decision_relevance: Supports passive thermal switch design for power electronics cooling.

problem: How can fluidic torque from spinning microrobots manipulate passive objects at low Reynolds number?
mechanism_or_method: Collective spinning magnetic microrobots generate bidirectional fluidic torque, studied in experiments and numerical simulation.
limitation: Laboratory-scale demonstrations; control precision and in vivo relevance not shown.

problem: How does bridging hydroxyl dynamics affect CO2 adsorption in ultra-small pore MOFs?
mechanism_or_method: DFT-trained machine-learning potential drives GCMC and hybrid GCMC-MD to capture mu2-OH reorientation and framework relaxation.
limitation: Single MOF; accuracy depends on MLP training set and lacks full experimental comparison in abstract.

object: heterogeneous crumpled polymer gas separation membranes
problem: How can polymer membranes achieve both high CO2 separation performance and structural robustness?
mechanism_or_method: Microzone interfacial polymerization creates a microphase-separated crumpled membrane with dual-function peak and valley regions.
limitation: Lab-scale films; long-term durability under real contaminated gas streams is not shown.

object: stretched elastic membranes with femtosecond laser scribing
problem: How can high aspect ratio microstructures be grown reversibly and rapidly on elastic membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Stretch-induced self-growth: femtosecond laser cutting of pre-stretched membranes, with release forming micropillars governed by stretch ratio.
limitation: Femtosecond laser patterning limits throughput; durability over many cycles not stated.

object: graphene quantum dot gas separation membranes
problem: Can one primitive membrane be post-tuned to meet varied gas separation needs?
mechanism_or_method: Stacked graphene quantum dot membrane with pores tuned by heat treatment and in-situ amine cross-linking.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; scalability and stability under humid or pressurized feeds not shown.

object: evanescent acoustic phonons on single-crystal surfaces
problem: What spin angular momentum do surface acoustic phonons carry in anisotropic crystals?
mechanism_or_method: Lattice-dynamics calculations plus ultrafast Sagnac interferometer imaging of GHz wave packets reveal intrinsic 3D spin angular momentum.
limitation: Single-crystal surface case; practical devices exploiting phonon spin are not demonstrated.

problem: What is the atomic-scale solution structure of amine carbon capture solvents in unloaded and CO2-loaded states?
mechanism_or_method: Empirical potential structure refinement of H/D isotopically varied neutron diffraction data for sodium and potassium glycinate.
limitation: Two model solvents only; requires large-facility neutron beamtime.

problem: How can thin, scalable zeolite membranes with high flux be synthesized?
mechanism_or_method: Embryonic zeolite-mediated suture strategy makes membrane thickness equal to the seed layer, validated for STT, CHA and MFI.
limitation: Tested on biogas-type mixtures; long-term industrial operation beyond 220 days not shown.

object: solid-state synthesis of single-crystalline NMC cathodes
problem: What multiscale processes compete during sintering of single-crystalline layered oxide cathodes?
mechanism_or_method: In situ synchrotron imaging and diffraction on LiNi0.5Mn0.3Co0.2O2 with Ba sintering aids.
limitation: One model composition and additive; requires synchrotron beamtime.

problem: Can alloy nanoparticles with atomic size mismatch above 15% be synthesized as single phase?
mechanism_or_method: Plasma-assisted carbothermal flash sintering compensates entropy loss and avoids slow nucleation, forming quasi-periodic lattice distortions.
limitation: Nanoparticle batch synthesis scale and stability of metastable phases not described.

problem: How can the strength-ductility trade-off in nanoprecipitate-strengthened lightweight steels be overcome?
mechanism_or_method: Atomic-scale strain waves make dislocations wavy and paired, forming hexagonal networks via cross-slip that raise strain hardening.
limitation: Lab-scale alloys; processing route for industrial production not addressed.
decision_relevance: Guides alloy design for lightweight high-strength ductile steels.

object: lithium extraction from brine mining slags
problem: Can lithium be extracted spontaneously without added energy, reagents or water?
mechanism_or_method: Humidity-controlled selective deliquescence of lithium chloride hydrate yields a lithium-rich concentrate while other salts remain solid.
limitation: Needs controlled humidity and LiCl-bearing slags; pilot-scale performance is not shown.

object: ultrathin network polymer membranes for H2/CO2
problem: Can in situ crystalline channels deliver pressure and temperature resistant H2/CO2 separation?
mechanism_or_method: Competitive-reaction interfacial polymerization creates crystalline segments tightly attached to an amorphous polymer network.
limitation: Short-term lab tests; long-term stability and large-area membranes not reported.

problem: Can magnetic coupling turn random snapping sequences into ordered, directional sequences?
mechanism_or_method: Intra- and interlayer magnetic interactions coupled with elasticity reprogram buckling order, producing chain-reaction snapping in multilayers.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; sensitivity to magnetization drift and fabrication imperfections is not quantified.
decision_relevance: Guides design of deterministic multistep snapping metamaterials without applied fields.

problem: Can a lightweight alloy achieve near-zero thermal expansion while retaining strength?
mechanism_or_method: Strain recovery compensation: embedded Al-stabilized MnCoGe particles undergoing reversible martensitic transformation maintain compressive strain.
limitation: Zero expansion only over 25-150 C; long-term cyclic stability not reported.
decision_relevance: Enables dimensionally stable lightweight components in thermally varying environments.

object: cholesteric liquid crystal elastomer hollow fibers
problem: How can director orientation be programmed in cholesteric elastomer fibers for multimodal actuation with color change?
mechanism_or_method: Anisotropic deswelling template method with boronic ester exchange; membrane balloon model with neo-classical LCE energy explains inflation motions.
limitation: Lab-scale fibers; durability and response speed over repeated cycles not reported.

problem: Can friction-induced selective atom removal create durable single-crystal nanostructures on sapphire?
mechanism_or_method: Tribochemical removal via interfacial bridge bonds with SiO2, supported by reactive force field MD; tested in triboelectric nanogenerators.
limitation: Tested against SiO2 counterface and 100k cycles; other counter materials and conditions not shown.
decision_relevance: Offers a wear-resistant nanostructuring route for sapphire friction surfaces.

problem: Can a lightweight durable suit deliver consistent electrotactile haptic feedback and therapy across the body?
mechanism_or_method: Textile compression garment with soft stimulators and calibration that monitors contact pressure and adjusts stimulation by site impedance.
limitation: Abstract gives no quantitative user study; therapeutic efficacy is not demonstrated.

problem: How can one robot integrate reprogrammable analog and logic computation through mechanical intelligence?
mechanism_or_method: Elastic wave metamaterials inspired by Fourier optics perform spatial analog computing with robot crawling, with nonlinear harmonics for parallel tasks.
limitation: Laboratory prototype; computing speed, scalability and robustness outside the lab are not shown.

problem: Do land-cover change and wealth outweigh physical factors in driving landslide fatalities globally?
mechanism_or_method: Statistical analysis of fatal landslide records, income, population, exposure and about 60 years of land-use change across 46 countries.
limitation: Correlational national-level analysis; landslide fatality records are incomplete and biased across countries.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes land-use planning over physical hazard mitigation in lower-income mountain countries.
